Method_1_Normal.Description: Standard iterative agentic pipeline. Good for simple independent documents.

How_It_Works.Ingestion: IngestionAgent reads EACH transcript individually. It extracts entities, data elements, and risks one file at a time using LLM calls. No cross-document correlation occurs at this stage.
How_It_Works.Schema_1: Not explicitly generated as an isolated step in this method's path (DFD is extracted directly from the ingested chunks).
How_It_Works.Data_Inventory: Not explicitly generated in this path.
How_It_Works.DFD_Generation: DFDExtractor takes the concatenated output of the individual ingestions and generates the dfd.json. It self-validates via a feedback loop. PrivacyDFDAgent then uses this output to render the Mermaid graph.

Method_2_RLM.Description: Recursive Language Model pipeline. Excellent for massive cross-document context reasoning.

How_It_Works.Ingestion: RLMIngestionAgent loads ALL transcripts into a single execution context. It uses a Python Code REPL to iteratively query parts of the text, deduplicate entities across different files programmatically, and build ONE unified ExtractedTranscriptData object.
How_It_Works.DFD_Generation: DFDExtractor takes the single highly-correlated RLM output and runs its extraction/validation loop to produce dfd.json. PrivacyDFDAgent uses this to render the Mermaid graph.

Method_3_FullPipeline.Description: The production robust hybrid pipeline (Deterministic + Agentic + AI Validation loops).

How_It_Works.Ingestion: PipelineRunner combines deterministic Python NLP (regex, basic parsing) with Agentic Extraction (SystemAgent, DataFlowAgent, RiskAgent) to create an initial data map.
How_It_Works.Schema_1: SchemaGeneratorAgent (used internally) takes the cleaned transcripts and generates a strict JSON representation of Nodes and Flows (Schema-1) using Anthropic tool calling.
How_It_Works.Data_Inventory: SchemaGeneratorAgent then strictly flattens Schema-1 into `DataMappingRow` arrays representing the inventory matrix.
How_It_Works.DFD_Generation: DFDBuilderAgent takes the normalized, canonicalized flows output by the PipelineVerificationAgent feedback loop to generate the final master DFD json and HTML representations.
